purpose: Move the deterministic 583-candidate fingerprint comparison into CI and publish a small content-addressed result that can be verified quickly by the diagnostic consumer.

must: compute every current price-blind taste fingerprint using the exact implementation contract
validate taste index structural shape and actual len(entries)
classify every feed candidate as exact cache hit or miss/stale
record exact counts and only non-hit details
bind result to exact Git tree/blob identities of all deterministic inputs

requires: exact candidate key exists in compact taste index
taste index profile_blob_sha equals the profile SHA already proven current by stage 04
taste index taste_model_version equals canonical policy model version
cached taste_fingerprint equals freshly computed current feed fingerprint

consumer_accept_only_if_all: current data/production/mailing Git tree SHA equals validation mailing_tree_sha
current data/cache/taste_fit.index.json blob SHA equals validation taste_index_blob_sha
current config/taste_fingerprint_contract.json blob SHA equals validation fingerprint_contract_blob_sha
validation profile_blob_sha equals current canonical profile SHA proven by stage 02/04
validation taste_model_version equals canonical policy taste model version
validation feed_candidate_count equals current mailing item_count
validation hit_count plus miss_or_stale_count equals feed_candidate_count

failure_behavior.stale_or_mismatched_attestation: invalid; do not use counts; targeted retest must wait for/rebuild current validation artifact or fall back to direct full mechanical validation

targeted_retest_dependencies: 03_feed_ingest_qa proof or exact current mailing tree identity
diagnostic_stage_07.output_needed_for_stage_08: non_hits list only; confirmed hits are not semantically reevaluated
